﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: spring-core 5.3.27 -> 6.0.8

## Context

Project `LPVS` (by Samsung) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.springframework:spring-core` from `5.3.27` to `6.0.8` (major update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/Samsung/LPVS/pull/151

## Your Task

The source code is in `/LPVS`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
